notes.title: Difficulty Update and Other Fixes
notes.notes:
I just added a feature to disable the emotions for a while after you lose control so that you have time to recharge all of your defenses and hopefully not lose control again immediately after.

Additionally:
Currencies no longer die at the end of the day.
More sound options.
The game pauses automatically when you set up a train of thought.
Emotions animate on death.
Better communication of damage.
Multiple minor bugfixes.
